correctness.rationale: The published block encoding of maximal consecutive-321 avoiding Lehmer codes has endpoint lengths {1,2} and interior lengths {2,3}; defect contributions are C(b,2). Setting e endpoint excess 0,1,2, u=#interior2, v=#interior3 gives n=2+e+2u+3v, d=e+u+3v. Hence u=n-2-d, e congruent 2d-n+2 mod 3, v=(2d-n+2-e)/3; nonnegative solutions have coefficient C(2,e)C(u+v,v), proving generating function (x+qx²)²/(1-qx²-q³x³). For n=2r+1, r>=5, consecutive coefficient triple (r-1,r-2,(r-2)(r-3)) has a strict valley. For n=2r, r>=7, triple (C(r-2,2),C(r-3,2),2C(r-3,3)) has a strict valley. Remaining n=2..10 and 12 are directly checked via exact formula, so unimodality iff 2<=n<=10 or n=12. Independently generated all binomial-formula coefficients for n=2..15 and checked each profile; inspected full source RESULT.md and its cited structural proof. Finite checks corroborate while valley families prove infinite n.
